content.short: Digital X, formerly Korbit, is South Korea's first crypto exchange, now run under Mirae Asset, with Korean won trading pairs.
content.description: Before any other Korean exchange existed, Korbit opened in 2013, and today it runs as Digital X inside Mirae Asset's financial group. Users trade a wide range of digital assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP, against the Korean won. The platform also offers ETH staking and overseas remittance. It operates under the rules of Korea's Financial Services Commission. The exchange now charges no trading fees and adds coin lending, recurring purchases, auto trading and an Open API, along with a separate service for corporate clients.
